rawFindings.title: Unwatched patterns still generate watch events when they share a watched directory
rawFindings.explanation: The ignored predicate now only receives exclude patterns, so files that match a `watched: false` pattern are not filtered out if another watched pattern causes the same parent directory to be watched. `fileList.changeFile` will still see those files in the file list and trigger the modified event.
rawFindings.suggestion: Pass the watched patterns into `createIgnore` again and ignore non-directory paths that do not match any watched pattern, while still applying excludes.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With files `[Pattern('/tmp/app/*.js', true, true, true), Pattern('/tmp/app/*.css', true, true, false)]` and no excludes, a change to `/tmp/app/style.css` is delivered by chokidar and causes `fileList.changeFile('/tmp/app/style.css')`, even though that pattern is marked `watched: false`.

rawFindings.title: Excluded directories can prevent watching included descendant files
rawFindings.explanation: The new ignore function applies exclude patterns to every chokidar item without checking whether the item is a directory. If an exclude pattern matches a directory itself but not its child files, chokidar can skip traversing that directory even though the file list includes matching files inside it.
rawFindings.suggestion: Keep directories unignored in the chokidar ignore callback, for example by using a stat-aware ignored callback and returning `false` for directories before applying exclude patterns.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With `files: ['/tmp/app/**/*.js']` and `exclude: ['/tmp/app/vendor']`, the initial file list still includes `/tmp/app/vendor/a.js` because that file does not match the exclude pattern, but chokidar ignores the `/tmp/app/vendor` directory and changes to `/tmp/app/vendor/a.js` are not reported.
